pages.title: Create Ratatouille
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Create machines for baking, threshing, squeezing, ripening and composting.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() The **Oven** is heated by a Blaze Burner; goggles show its level.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Its salt, cocoa powder and butter are the pack's only ones.
**Create Ratatouille** adds farm-to-table machines: bulk baking, grain threshing, squeezing, crop ripening and composting. It sits beside Farmer's Delight rather than replacing it.

pages.title: Oven
pages.text: A [#](7A3C9A)[multiblock](entry://glossary/multiblock)[#]() heated by a [#](2E5AAC)[Blaze Burner](entry://create_basics/heat)[#](). Oven Fans keep air moving. Better heat, air and space means faster bulk baking and smoking. Use [#](2E5AAC)[goggles](entry://create_basics/tools_wrench)[#]() to read its level.

pages.title: Thresher
pages.text: Processes grain and crops, and works well on a belt. Output slides out the side. Recipes are listed under Threshing in [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#]().

pages.title: Squeeze Basin
pages.text: Squeezes and fills. Products leave from the side with a port, and it also takes fluid. A Deployer can make it faster.

pages.title: Spreader
pages.text: Ripens crops in an area by spending Ripen Matter. With Mature Matter it puts animals in love mode. Speed and a nozzle widen its reach.

pages.title: Irrigation Tower
pages.text: Keeps farmland in range moist from a water tank. Fill it with Compost Tea and it slowly turns farmland into Farmer's Delight Rich Soil Farmland.

**Compost Tower** composts food waste into compost products. The **Mechanical Demolder** frees items from moulds such as chocolate, cake and popsicle moulds.\
\
Related: [#](2E5AAC)[Sweets and Drinks](entry://food/sweets_and_drinks)[#]().\
\
Soil basics: [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().

pages.title: Salt
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** The pack's one salt. Heated boil stone makes it, and Northstar's brine and basalt recipes now give it too. Leftover Northstar salt [#](7A3C9A)[converts 1:1](entry://glossary/canonical_item)[#]() in a crafting grid.

pages.title: Cocoa Powder and Butter
pages.text: The pack's one cocoa powder and butter. Ratatouille presses and mills them; Confectionery's chocolate now uses them. Old Confectionery cocoa converts 1:1.
